data.name: HelpAbout
data.value:
RetroWorks ][ version 1.4
An integrated Word Processor, Data Base and Spreadsheet in the style of the 80-column, green-screen productivity software of the Apple ][ years.
Written from scratch in C# / Blazor WebAssembly. It is not AppleWorks, contains no Apple code, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.
The Desktop holds up to 12 open files. Escape always takes you back to the Main Menu; Alt-Q ("Quick Change") jumps straight to another file.
Files are plain JSON: .rwp (word processor) .rdb (data base) .rss (spreadsheet)
Alt takes the place of the Open-Apple key. Alt-K shows the help for whichever kind of file you are working on.

data.name: HelpWP
data.value:
WORD PROCESSOR COMMANDS (Alt replaces the Open-Apple key)
Arrows ............ move the cursor Alt-T / Alt-G .. top / bottom PgUp / PgDn ....... page up / down Home / End ....... start / end of line Return ............ new paragraph Alt-E ........... Insert / Overwrite Delete ............ delete left Alt-D ........... delete right Tab ............... 4 spaces Alt-Y ........... clear to end of paragraph
Alt-X ............ cut paragraph Alt-C ........... copy paragraph Alt-V ............ paste paragraph(s) above the cursor
Alt-F ............ find (again) Alt-R ........... replace all Alt-W ............ spell check: 1/2=pick A=accept R=replace I=gnore S=kip (English words only; Hebrew text is not checked) Alt-P ............ "print" to a plain .txt file (76 columns, download) Alt-L ............ paragraph direction: left-to-right / right-to-left Alt-B ............ bold on / off Alt-U ........... underline on / off
Alt-S ............ save to disk Alt-Shift-S ..... download file Alt-Q ............ quick change Alt-K / F1 ...... this help Escape ............ Main Menu
Bold and underline apply to what you type next; press the key again to turn them off. Printing to a .txt file keeps the text only.
Text wraps automatically. The bottom line shows the line, column, cursor mode, word count and the direction of the current paragraph. A right-to-left paragraph is aligned to the right margin; new paragraphs keep the direction of the one you pressed Return in.

data.name: HelpSS
data.value:
SPREADSHEET COMMANDS (Alt replaces the Open-Apple key)
Arrows / Tab ...... move PgUp / PgDn ...... page Alt-T ............ go to A1 Alt-B ........... last used cell Alt-G ............ go to a cell Alt-F ........... find text
Just start typing to make an entry; Return, Tab or an arrow enters it. Return / Alt-U ... edit the current entry Delete .... blank the cell
VALUES start with a digit or + - . = @ ( for example: +A1*B1 =(B2+B3)/2 @SUM(A1...A10) @AVG(B1:B9) LABELS are anything else. Start with " to force a label ("1984). A label that starts with \ repeats across the cell: \- \=
Functions: @SUM @AVG @MIN @MAX @COUNT @ABS @INT @ROUND(x,n) @SQRT @MOD(x,y) @IF(cond,a,b) @EXP @LN @LOG @SIN @COS @TAN @ATAN @PI Operators: + - * / ^ and comparisons < > = <= >= <> (true = 1) $A$1 is an absolute reference; A1 is relative.
Alt-C / Alt-X / Alt-V .. copy / cut / paste a cell (formulas adjust) Alt-R ............ replicate the cell down/across to a target cell Alt-N ............ insert a row Alt-D ........... delete the row Alt-W ............ column width Alt-P ........... export values to CSV Alt-S ............ save to disk Alt-Shift-S ..... download file Alt-Q ............ quick change Escape .......... Main Menu / Alt-K help

data.name: HelpDB
data.value:
DATA BASE COMMANDS (Alt replaces the Open-Apple key)
Alt-Z ............ zoom: switch Multiple-record / Single-record layout
Multiple records: Up/Down = record Left/Right/Tab = category Single record: Up/Down = category Left/Right, PgUp/PgDn = record Alt-T / Alt-B ... first / last record
Just start typing to change the highlighted entry. Return / Alt-U ... edit the entry (Return/Tab inside moves to the next) Delete ............ blank the entry
Alt-N ............ add a new record (type each entry, Escape ends) Alt-D ............ delete this record Alt-C / Alt-V ... copy this record / paste it as a new record
Alt-F ............ select only records containing some text (Return on an empty line selects all again) Alt-A ............ arrange (sort) by this category; again = reverse Alt-E ............ change categories: rename, insert, delete, move Alt-W ............ width of this category in the table Alt-P ............ export the selected records to CSV Alt-S ............ save to disk Alt-Shift-S ..... download file Alt-Q ............ quick change Escape .......... Main Menu / Alt-K help
